Zelenskyy Responds to Trump's Call for Ukraine Elections

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that it is "up to our people" to decide on elections, responding to a pledge by former U.S. President Donald Trump to push for new elections in Ukraine. Trump's statement suggested that Ukraine should hold elections, implying a potential shift in U.S. policy regarding the ongoing conflict.
